rubric.error: Application error or no substantive terminal answer within 120 seconds.
rubric.fail: Wrong facts/calculation/attribution, unjustified clarification, unsupported capability, wrong requested output container.
rubric.partial: Correct substantive answer missing a requested fact.
rubric.pass: All requested facts and explicit output constraints correct, no invented claims or unwanted persistence.
